highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves Android rendering cadence and reduces allocation overhead in image, stream, and text-shaping paths.
highlights_body: Android texture rendering now follows display refresh, while managed pixel copies, HarfBuzz text shaping, feature-string decoding, and front-buffered streams avoid unnecessary retained memory or allocations.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows display refresh
bullets.detail: Texture-backed rendering on Android is synchronized with the display refresh cadence for smoother presentation.

bullets.lead: Image pixel copies use less managed overhead
bullets.detail: Managed image pixel-copy operations avoid unnecessary work, reducing overhead when applications transfer pixel data.
HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding reuses a pooled buffer, and feature-string decoding avoids an unnecessary native allocation.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily
bullets.detail: Front-buffered streams release retained data correctly, reducing memory retention during stream-based decoding and processing.
